$comment: The built-in extension catalogue, replacing the keiyoushi APK index the old server downloaded at runtime. One entry per module in src/sources/sites; the GraphQL layer serves this list but ignores any entry whose pkgName the registry does not know, so drift can only ever hide a source, never invent one. Ids are decimal Longs as strings, stable forever: they are stored on every manga row and in the client's saved searches. Never reuse or renumber one. 1000000000000000007 (MANGA Plus) and 1000000000000000008 (Bato.to) are burnt, not free — see the notes at the end.
name: Built-in

$reserved.1000000000000000007: MANGA Plus by SHUEISHA. Its API works (protobuf over HTTP, one SESSION-TOKEN header), but every page image is XOR-encrypted with a per-page key the viewer is expected to apply. Nothing in the Source contract can transform image bytes, and the reader/download pipeline that fetches them is a different module, so a shipped source would browse and list chapters and then show a blank reader. Deliberately not shipped.
$reserved.1000000000000000008: Bato.to. Every mirror serves a Cloudflare interstitial to plain requests, so its markup could not be read even once; writing selectors against a page nobody has seen is the exact silent-failure mode this catalogue avoids. Needs a FlareSolverr-backed session to be written at all.
